### The Word of the Lord through Micah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/word-lord-through-micah
Passage: Micah 1:2
Points:
- Micah prophesied to both Israel and Judah as the Assyrian empire advanced to execute divine judgment.
- While God marching into battle normally brought salvation, the people's idolatry turned them into His enemies.
- Societal injustice and ethical corruption among the leadership were rooted fundamentally in false worship.
- Samaria's wealth obtained through pagan temple prostitution would be stripped away and left in ruins.
- Spiritual growth requires believers to unmask modern idols and find lasting satisfaction in Christ alone.
